verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection service that handles user credentials and tool traffic, so a policy on using customer data for AI training is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers training data use, opt-outs, or data-retention policy. Encrypted credential storage and token scoping are adjacent security controls, not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
